import os import json import time import re import random from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright from bs4 import BeautifulSoup import dateparser # ================= 配置区域 ================= OUTPUT_DIR = "./output" TARGET_URL = "https://www.seczambia.org.zm/resources/multimedia/news/" MAX_ITEMS = 5 HEADLESS = True os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True) # ================= 工具函数 ================= def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 将相对路径转换为绝对路径 2. 移除无用标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) # 移除脚本和样式 for script in soup(["script", "style"]): script.decompose() return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def extract_date_from_text(text): """ 从文本中提取日期 """ if not text: return None patterns = [ r'(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})', # 2025-10-14 r'([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?,?\s+(\d{4})', # October 14, 2025 r'(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{4})', # 14 October 2025 r'(\d{1,2})[./](\d{1,2})[./](\d{4})', # 14/10/2025 ] for pattern in patterns: match = re.search(pattern, text) if match: try: dt = dateparser.parse(match.group(0)) if dt: return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except: continue return None def save_results(articles: list, output_path: str): """保存结果为JSON""" result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "articles": articles } with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"已保存 {len(articles)} 条新闻到 {output_path}") # ================= 爬虫逻辑 ================= def crawl_detail_page(context, url): """爬取详情页内容""" page = context.new_page() try: # 如果是PDF直接返回 if url.lower().endswith('.pdf'): return {"content": f"

PDF Document: {url}

", "date_from_detail": None} print(f"正在抓取详情页: {url}") page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) try: page.wait_for_timeout(2000) except: pass content_html = "" # 增强的正文选择器列表 content_selectors = [ "div.elementor-widget-theme-post-content", "div.elementor-widget-text-editor", ".entry-content", ".post-content", "article .content", "div[class*='content']", "main" ] for selector in content_selectors: if page.locator(selector).count() > 0: # 针对 Elementor 文本编辑器的特殊处理 if "text-editor" in selector: elements = page.locator(selector).all() # 拼接所有文本编辑器内容 full_html = "" for el in elements: full_html += el.inner_html() content_html = full_html else: content_html = page.locator(selector).first.inner_html() if content_html and len(content_html) > 100: break cleaned_content = clean_html_content(content_html, url) extracted_date = None try: # 尝试从页面元数据或时间标签提取日期 time_el = page.locator("time").first if time_el.count(): extracted_date = extract_date_from_text(time_el.get_attribute("datetime") or time_el.inner_text()) if not extracted_date: # 扫描页面前1500个字符 body_text = page.locator("body").inner_text()[:1500] extracted_date = extract_date_from_text(body_text) except: pass return { "content": cleaned_content, "date_from_detail": extracted_date } except Exception as e: print(f"详情页抓取失败 {url}: {e}") return {"content": "", "date_from_detail": None} finally: page.close() def crawl_news(): """主爬虫函数""" with sync_playwright() as p: browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=HEADLESS, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) page = context.new_page() articles = [] seen_urls = set() try: print(f"访问列表页: {TARGET_URL}") page.goto(TARGET_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000) page.wait_for_timeout(5000) # 等待动态加载 # === 策略1: 尝试标准新闻卡片 === # 扩展选择器以覆盖更多情况 card_selectors = [ "article", ".elementor-post", ".post", ".news-item", ".blog-entry", "div[class*='post-']", "div.card" ] potential_cards = [] for sel in card_selectors: found = page.locator(sel).all() if len(found) > 0: potential_cards = found print(f"使用选择器 '{sel}' 找到 {len(found)} 个潜在条目") break for item in potential_cards: if len(articles) >= MAX_ITEMS: break try: # 提取标题和链接 title_el = item.locator("h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, a.title, .entry-title a").first if not title_el.count(): # 尝试直接找链接 title_el = item.locator("a").first if not title_el.count(): continue title = title_el.inner_text().strip() # 如果找到的是标题容器，找里面的链接 link_el = title_el if title_el.get_attribute("href") else title_el.locator("a").first if not link_el.count(): # 回溯到卡片找链接 link_el = item.locator("a").first if not link_el.count(): continue href = link_el.get_attribute("href") if not href: continue full_url = urljoin(TARGET_URL, href) if full_url in seen_urls: continue # 提取日期 date_str = None time_el = item.locator("time").first if time_el.count(): date_str = extract_date_from_text(time_el.get_attribute("datetime") or time_el.inner_text()) if not date_str: date_str = extract_date_from_text(item.inner_text()) articles.append({ "title": title, "date": date_str, "sourceUrl": full_url, "summary": "", "source": "SEC Zambia", "author": "SEC Zambia" }) seen_urls.add(full_url) except Exception as e: print(f"卡片提取出错: {e}") # === 策略2: 兜底链接采集 (如果策略1未找到足够数据) === if len(articles) < MAX_ITEMS: print("策略1未满足数量，启动兜底链接采集...") # 查找主内容区域的所有链接 main_area = page.locator("main, #content, .content, body").first links = main_area.locator("a").all() for link in links: if len(articles) >= MAX_ITEMS: break if not link.is_visible(): continue text = link.inner_text().strip() href = link.get_attribute("href") # 过滤无效链接 if not text or len(text) < 15: continue # 标题太短通常不是新闻 if not href or href.startswith("#") or "javascript" in href: continue full_url = urljoin(TARGET_URL, href) if full_url in seen_urls: continue # 排除常见非新闻词汇 if any(x in text.lower() for x in ['read more', 'click here', 'contact', 'home', 'about', 'privacy']): continue # 排除同一域名的非内容页 (简单启发式) path = urlparse(full_url).path if path == "/" or path == "": continue print(f"兜底发现链接: {text}") articles.append({ "title": text, "date": None, # 稍后在详情页获取 "sourceUrl": full_url, "summary": "", "source": "SEC Zambia", "author": "SEC Zambia" }) seen_urls.add(full_url) # === 详情页补全 === print(f"开始抓取 {len(articles)} 条新闻的详情内容...") for i, article in enumerate(articles): print(f"[{i+1}/{len(articles)}] 处理: {article['title']}") detail = crawl_detail_page(context, article['sourceUrl']) article['content'] = detail['content'] if not article['date'] and detail['date_from_detail']: article['date'] = detail['date_from_detail'] article['id'] = str(i + 1) time.sleep(1) except Exception as e: print(f"爬虫运行出错: {e}") finally: browser.close() return articles def main(): # 开始爬取 articles = crawl_news() # 生成文件名 timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"seczambia_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) # 保存结果 if articles: save_results(articles, output_path) else: print("未抓取到任何新闻数据") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
